title: Visual Project Map — End-to-End Workflow
description: How the visual-project-map tool works: an AI skill generates interactive DAGs from project structure, and a Cytoscape.js viewer renders them in the browser with progressive disclosure. Data artifacts between stages are shown as separate clickable modules.

modules.label: Discover
modules.description: Phase 1 of the skill: scan the target project's documentation, scripts, and file structure to build a structured inventory of its workflow.

outputs.name: Project inventory
outputs.description: Structured catalog of docs, scripts, I/O patterns, workflow hints

modules.label: Project Inventory
modules.description: The structured inventory produced by discovery — docs found, scripts grouped by directory, file I/O patterns, and workflow hints extracted from documentation.

inputs.name: Discovery results
inputs.description: Raw signals from scanning docs, code, and I/O patterns

outputs.name: Project inventory
outputs.description: Structured catalog ready for module design

modules.label: Design
modules.description: Phase 2: transform the project inventory into a graph blueprint — modules with interface contracts that chain, verified against structural constraints.

inputs.name: Project inventory
inputs.description: Docs, scripts, I/O patterns from discovery

outputs.name: Module blueprint
outputs.description: Module definitions with interface contracts and chaining verification

modules.label: Module Blueprint
modules.description: The verified blueprint: module definitions with IDs, labels, colors, interface contracts, and chaining verification. Ready for node/edge population.

outputs.name: Module blueprint
outputs.description: Verified blueprint ready for node/edge population

modules.label: Assemble
modules.description: Phase 3: populate the blueprint with nodes and edges, validate against schema.json and graph properties, enforce the 1-edge-per-module-pair rule, and write the JSON file.

modules.label: Graph JSON
modules.description: The graph JSON file written to .graphs/{name}.json. Contains title, modules, nodes, edges, and optional legend. Conforms to schema.json.

outputs.name: Graph JSON file
outputs.description: .graphs/{name}.json — served via HTTP to the viewer

modules.label: Render
modules.description: Load the JSON file, validate it, build Cytoscape elements with styles and parent-child relationships, and run dagre layout. All modules start collapsed.

outputs.name: Interactive graph
outputs.description: Cytoscape.js canvas with dagre layout, all modules collapsed

modules.label: Interactive Graph
modules.description: The rendered interactive graph in the browser — a Cytoscape.js canvas with collapsed modules, dagre layout, legend, toolbar, and status bar.

outputs.name: Interactive graph
outputs.description: Browser UI ready for user exploration

modules.label: Interact
modules.description: User-driven exploration: expand/collapse modules, hover for tooltips, click for detail panels, trace paths, search nodes, switch view modes, watch for changes.

inputs.name: Rendered graph
inputs.description: Cytoscape.js instance with all interaction handlers attached

outputs.name: User insight
outputs.description: Understanding of project structure, data flow, decision points, and dependencies

nodes.label: Project directory
nodes.description: Filesystem path to the project root, with optional --focus, --depth, and --title flags.

interfaceContract.name: Project directory
interfaceContract.description: Root directory of the target project to analyze

nodes.label: discover.read_docs
nodes.description: Find and read CLAUDE.md, README.md, Makefile, package.json. Extract workflow sections, command blocks, and actor signals.

nodes.label: discover.scan_scripts
nodes.description: Glob for scripts (*.py, *.ts, *.sh, *.R). Group by parent directory — each directory with 2+ scripts is a candidate module.

nodes.label: discover.detect_io
nodes.description: Grep key scripts for I/O patterns: open/read_csv (inputs), to_csv/json.dump (outputs), import paths (dependencies).

nodes.label: discover.synthesize
nodes.description: Combine all signals into a mental model: major phases, data flows, decision points, actor assignments, module interface sketches.

nodes.label: inventory.docs
nodes.description: Documentation files found during discovery — CLAUDE.md, README.md, ROADMAP.md — with extracted workflow sections, architecture notes, and design philosophy.

outputs.name: Architecture summary
outputs.description: Three JS modules loaded as script tags in order

outputs.name: Design decisions
outputs.description: Key choices: no build step, custom CollapseManager, dagre layout

nodes.label: inventory.scripts
nodes.description: Scripts grouped by directory: viewer/src/ (3 JS files — the runtime), scripts/ (serve.py), skills/ (SKILL.md + foundations). Each directory is a candidate module.

outputs.name: Script inventory
outputs.description: Scripts grouped by directory with line counts and function signatures

nodes.label: inventory.io_patterns
nodes.description: Detected file I/O patterns: serve.py reads graph JSON and copies to examples/; viewer.js fetches via URL parameter; CollapseManager reads/writes Cytoscape elements in memory.

inputs.name: Script contents
inputs.description: Grep results for open(), read_csv, json.dump, etc.

outputs.name: I/O pattern map
outputs.format: { script: string, reads: string[], writes: string[] }[]

nodes.label: inventory.workflow
nodes.description: Workflow hints extracted from docs: the skill runs in 3 phases (Discovery, Generation, Assembly), the viewer has 3 JS modules loaded in order, and serve.py bridges them.

nodes.label: design.define_modules
nodes.description: Identify modules from folder structure first, then docs. Assign colors from palette. Verify each has a clear 1-in-1-out interface. Target 3-10 modules.

nodes.label: design.write_interfaces
nodes.description: For each module, define interface.inputs and interface.outputs with name, description, format, and example. Contracts must chain: output of module N matches input of N+1.

nodes.label: design.verify_constraints
nodes.description: Check: 1 edge per module pair? 3-8 nodes per module? Internal edges > external? Contracts chain correctly?

nodes.label: blueprint.modules
nodes.description: Module definitions with id, label, color, borderColor, optional parent and interface. Each module has a clear purpose expressible in one sentence.

outputs.name: Module definitions
outputs.description: Complete module objects ready for JSON

nodes.label: blueprint.contracts
nodes.description: Interface contracts define data crossing module boundaries. Output format of module N must match input format of module N+1 to ensure the pipeline chains correctly.

nodes.label: blueprint.constraints
nodes.description: Verify: 3-10 modules, 3-8 nodes each, 1 edge per module pair, internal > external edges, contracts chain, no level-skipping edges.

nodes.label: assemble.populate_nodes
nodes.description: Create nodes with IDs (mod_state format), labels (module.state dot notation), shapes (round-rectangle/diamond/ellipse), trust levels, file annotations, and descriptions.

nodes.label: assemble.connect_edges
nodes.description: Create edges with labels, styles (solid/dashed), actors (human/ai/script/mixed), and details. Enforce 1-edge-per-module-pair rule.

nodes.label: assemble.validate
nodes.description: Validate: all references resolve, no duplicate IDs, no circular parents, schema.json compliance, 8-40 node scope.

nodes.label: assemble.write_json
nodes.description: Write the complete graph to .graphs/{name}.json with 2-space indentation. Present summary table to user before writing.

nodes.label: json.structure
nodes.description: Top-level JSON structure: title, modules[], nodes[], edges[], optional legend and description. Each field has required and optional properties defined in schema.json.

nodes.label: json.concrete_example
nodes.description: A concrete minimal graph: 2 modules (Ingest, Export), 3 nodes, 2 edges. Produces a collapsed view with 1 meta-edge. See examples/minimal.json.

nodes.label: json.output_file
nodes.description: Output file at .graphs/{name}.json — human-readable, version-controllable, git-diffable. serve.py copies it to the viewer's examples/ directory and starts the HTTP server.

nodes.label: render.fetch_validate
nodes.description: serve.py copies graph to examples/ and starts HTTP server. The viewer fetches JSON via ?graph= URL, then runs validateGraph() — shows error panel on failure.

nodes.label: render.build_elements
nodes.description: Convert JSON modules/nodes/edges into Cytoscape elements with data attributes, parent-child relationships, and color/shape/border styles.

nodes.label: render.dagre_layout
nodes.description: Run dagre hierarchical layout (TB direction, longest-path ranker). Collapse all modules, build legend, apply initial styles.

nodes.label: graph.collapsed_view
nodes.description: The primary interface: each module as a colored rectangle with meta-edges between them. Sufficient for understanding overall data flow at a glance.

nodes.label: graph.expanded_view
nodes.description: Click a module to expand and reveal internal nodes/edges. CollapseManager restores children via cy.add(), rebuilds edges, and re-runs dagre layout.

nodes.label: graph.view_modes
nodes.description: 6 view modes cycled with V key: Module (default), Provenance (trust), Actor (who), Files (I/O paths), Plan (overlay), Diff (compare versions).

nodes.label: interact.expand_collapse
nodes.description: Click modules to toggle expand/collapse. CollapseManager removes/restores children via cy.remove/cy.add, rebuilds deduplicated meta-edges. Breadcrumb tracks drill-down path.

nodes.label: interact.hover_and_trace
nodes.description: Hover nodes for neighborhood highlighting, hover edges for label tooltips. Click leaf nodes to see details in side panel. Shift+click for full upstream/downstream path trace.

nodes.label: interact.view_modes
nodes.description: V key cycles view modes. Each recolors the graph to emphasize a different dimension. Legend updates per view.

nodes.label: interact.tools
nodes.description: Search by label (/ key), minimap overview (M key), watch mode for auto-reload (W key), edge label toggle (L key), fit to viewport (F key).

nodes.label: User understanding
nodes.description: The user's mental model: major components, data flows, decision points, and who does what — formed through progressive disclosure.

interfaceContract.name: User understanding
interfaceContract.description: Mental model of the project formed through progressive disclosure
interfaceContract.format: Human comprehension of project structure, data flow, decision points, and actor responsibilities

edges.label: produce inventory
edges.description: Discovery outputs a structured project inventory: documentation files with workflow sections, scripts grouped by directory, detected file I/O patterns, and workflow hints from docs

edges.label: feed design
edges.description: The project inventory feeds into module design — folder structure becomes module boundaries, docs confirm and label the modules

edges.label: revise boundaries
edges.description: If constraints fail, revise module boundaries and try again

edges.label: constraints pass
edges.description: When all constraints are satisfied, the verified module blueprint is ready

edges.label: populate graph
edges.description: The verified blueprint drives node and edge creation

edges.label: restructure
edges.description: If validation fails, restructure nodes and edges

edges.label: write file
edges.description: The complete graph is written to .graphs/{name}.json

edges.label: serve & load
edges.description: serve.py copies JSON into viewer's examples/, starts HTTP server, opens browser

edges.label: render
edges.description: Dagre layout applied, all modules collapsed, legend and toolbar rendered

edges.label: explore
edges.description: User begins exploring through progressive disclosure
